answer: Each agent stakes a KZG commitment binding its identity to a recursive zk-SNARK attestation, so a sybil must replicate the full proof chain like cloning a garden from seed. Aggregated proofs across the elliptic curve cycle let peers verify an atlas of attested identities without trusting any single lantern-bearer. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
